title: Commercial establishment processed with failure
description: Per-item failure outcome of a Tangara commercial establishment batch registration/update. One event is emitted per failed item to the commercial_establishment_processed_failure event type.

key.title: Key
key.description: Client-provided identifier of the commercial establishment item within the batch

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: List of processing errors for the item

code.title: Error code
code.description: Business error code. [090001=EC already exists] [090002=EC not found] [090003=invalid request]
